Hi Markus,

I lead the Data & Robotics Lab at Small State University. We ran a small pilot with Redwood last spring with great results for undergraduate projects (speech-to-text assistive demos). A few of those students are returning this summer for an expanded mentorship cohort and we were hoping to continue using Redwood for model inference.

Two asks:
- Can you grant a short trial extension (roughly 90 days) so the cohort can finish their projects without interruptions?
- Is there any educational credit or promotional support available for public university labs? We are a state-funded lab and budgets are tight.

I can share a short MOU and a list of students. Would also like to confirm data retention / student data handling for research projects. Happy to sign any standard paperwork.

Thanks — Andrew
